item.title: Winona Man Injured in Saturday Afternoon Crash
item.description: A Winona resident was injured in a crash near Caufield on Saturday. The accident occurred on County Road 7080 just after noon. The 37-year-old Winona man ran off the roadway in his 2000 Ford F150 and struck a tree and was transported to Ozarks Healthcare in West Plains for treatment of minor injuries.
